_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Higgsfield AI offer (spec section 7).
Nothing about this offer may be typed into a component. Every price, credit
count, model name, date and claim on /product/higgsfield-ai-bangladesh is read
from this file and gated by scripts/validate-higgsfield-offer.mjs at build time.
Two DIFFERENT kinds of fact live here and must never be merged:
1. platform.*  — what the Higgsfield product itself does. Verifiable from the
vendor's own public pages. Cite sourceUrl + verifiedOn for each.
2. offer.*     — what AI Premium Shop sells and at what price. Owner-attested.
AIPS can verify its own service price; it CANNOT verify vendor entitlements
(credit counts, 'unlimited' models, Supercomputer scope) without either
current vendor documentation or written authorization.
Anything in the second category that is not verified goes in pendingVerification
and is rendered as an open question, never as a feature bullet.

platform.summary: Higgsfield is an AI video and image creation platform. It generates video from text prompts and from still images, with cinematic camera-motion controls, talking-avatar and lip-sync output, and UGC-style ad formats. Plans are credit-based and cover individuals, teams and enterprise.
capabilities: Image-to-video animation from a still product photo

notSuitableFor: Long-form video — this is a short-clip generator, not a replacement for an editor on a 20-minute piece.
Frame-exact brand control — generated footage varies between runs; if a client signs off shot-by-shot, generation is the wrong tool.
Work requiring a real named person's likeness — you need that person's permission, and no subscription grants it.
Anyone expecting unlimited output. Every credit-based plan has a ceiling; see the credits section.

Anyone who needs fast, parallel Supercomputer or agent-workflow generation on the entry plan — those tools always spend credits regardless of plan, and 'unlimited' mode itself runs one generation at a time on a relaxed queue, not in parallel.

platformVerifiedFacts._note: General facts about the Higgsfield platform confirmed against the vendor's own current terms/blog pages (not this specific AIPS offer's tier or entitlements — those stay in pendingVerification). Each item is safe to state as fact site-wide; do not infer from these that AIPS's proposed 1,200-credit Plus offer includes any of them without separately confirming the plan.

items.claim: "Unlimited" is not a plan — it's a toggle available via a 1-day free trial, a 7-day window bundled with Plus/Max/Ultra, or a separate paid "Unlimited Models Marketplace" bundle. It covers all 11 image, 7 video and 5 audio models across all three paths.
"Unlimited" never covers MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, Marketing Studio or Shorts Studio — those spend credits regardless of plan or unlimited status.
"Unlimited" mode runs on a relaxed queue: one image, one video and one audio generation at a time — not in parallel. Credit-paid generations use a separate, faster priority queue.
4K output under unlimited mode is limited to Max-annual and Ultra-annual plans; other tiers cap at 1080p.

Supercomputer requires a paid plan ("Plus or above" for most meaningful actions) and is never free — an example animation step (Seedance 2.0, 10s, 1080p, High) costs ~90 credits (~$4.50); a full production workflow ~200 credits (~$10).

Account/login credential sharing is expressly prohibited ("You may not share your Account or login credentials with anyone"), and creating an account on behalf of another individual is prohibited except for an entity the creator is authorized to represent — AIPS has no such authorization (see compliance.authorizationOnFile). This is why this offer's account-ownership model requires the customer to create and hold their own account.
Commercial use of generated Inputs/Outputs is unrestricted — Higgsfield claims no ownership and places no commercial-use limit on what a customer generates.

pendingVerification._note: Claims supplied as business inputs that are NOT yet backed by current vendor documentation or written authorization. These render as open questions on the page. Move an item into platform.capabilities or offer.* only with a sourceUrl and a verifiedOn date.

credits.explainer: Higgsfield plans are credit-based: each generation spends credits, and different models and clip lengths cost different amounts. Two things follow. First, a monthly credit figure is a budget, not a video count — a longer clip on a heavier model costs more than a short one on a light model. Second, any 'unlimited' offer needs a stated scope: unlimited on which models, through which interface, and under what fair-use ceiling. AI Premium Shop will not quote a credit figure for this offer until it is confirmed against the vendor's current pricing page and the account itself.
questionsToAsk: How many credits does this plan actually include this month?
Which models are credit-free, and which spend credits?
What does one 5-second clip cost on the model I want to use?
Do credits roll over, or expire at the end of the billing month?
Does the Supercomputer / agent workflow spend credits from the same pool?

payment.note: No international card required. This is the whole reason the service exists — Higgsfield bills in USD and most Bangladeshi debit cards cannot complete that charge.

process.body: Tell us what you want to make — product ads, reels, avatars. We confirm the current vendor plan and the live price before anything is paid.
You sign up at higgsfield.ai with your own email and set your own password. You keep recovery access. We never ask for your password.
We handle the USD side of the subscription payment that a local card cannot complete. The service fee and the subscription cost are stated separately before you pay.
A live walkthrough: first render, how credits are spent, and which model suits the work you described.
The subscription is on your account. You control renewal and cancellation directly with the vendor.

faq.a: You do. You create it with your own email, set your own password, and keep recovery access. AI Premium Shop assists with the payment and the setup — it does not hold, share or resell logins.

faq.q: Why does AI Premium Shop use this model instead of a shared or pre-made account?
faq.a: Higgsfield's own terms of use prohibit sharing account credentials with anyone and prohibit creating an account on behalf of another individual without written authorization to represent them — which AI Premium Shop does not have. A customer-owned account, set up by the customer themselves with our assistance, is the only model consistent with those terms.

faq.q: Is AI Premium Shop an official Higgsfield partner?
faq.a: No. We are an independent service and have no reseller, affiliate or partnership authorization from Higgsfield. We help Bangladeshi customers pay for and set up a subscription they own themselves.

faq.q: Why is the price confirmed on WhatsApp instead of shown as a checkout?
faq.a: Because the vendor's plan pricing and entitlements change, and this specific offer has not been re-verified against Higgsfield's current pricing page. Quoting a live figure and confirming it before payment is more honest than publishing a number that may already be stale.

faq.q: Can you guarantee unlimited video generation?
faq.a: No. Every credit-based plan has limits, and we will not describe any plan as unlimited without the vendor's current documentation stating the exact scope — which models, which interfaces, and what fair-use ceiling applies.

faq.q: How do I pay from Bangladesh?
faq.a: bKash, Nagad, Rocket or bank transfer. No international card is needed on your side.

faq.q: What happens when the month ends?
faq.a: The subscription sits on your own account, so renewal and cancellation are yours to control directly with Higgsfield. Nothing renews through us.

Refund terms for a customer-owned third-party subscription are set by the vendor, not by us. Before you pay, ask us what is and is not recoverable for your specific case — we would rather tell you upfront than argue after.
